## T06 second-stage contract recheck — FAIL

**1 blocking, 1 should_fix.** Focused90 passed **90/90** on Node `v24.22.3` with **76 metrics tests and 14 team tests**. All **19 requested changed-case assertions** matched after correcting the positive-control fixtures. Two additional cases directly exercising the new link-label check exposed one false-rejection defect. This was an independent Codex context using the same OpenAI provider. [Focused log](/tmp/pace-t06-r22-independent.L3lCgJ/focused90.log)

### Findings

1. **Blocking · T-4 · `finish` rejects visible Markdown cells.** The new label regex scans the raw cell without accounting for escapes or link titles. A summary containing `[범위](details.md "[⠀](sample.md)")` renders a link labeled `범위`. A summary containing `비교 \[⠀](details.md)` renders ordinary visible text. Both returned **1** with the team-row visibility error, expected **0**. The `⠀` in both inputs is literal U+2800. The fix needs to identify actual link labels while continuing to reject filler-only labels. [Validator](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-retrospective.ts:47) · [Link-title result](/tmp/pace-t06-r22-independent.L3lCgJ/probes/projection/visible-link-with-title.finish.json) · [Escaped-bracket result](/tmp/pace-t06-r22-independent.L3lCgJ/probes/projection/visible-literal-escaped-bracket.finish.json) · [Rendered cells](/tmp/pace-t06-r22-independent.L3lCgJ/markdown-render.log)
2. **Should fix · T-5 · A whole `PROJECT-CLOSE.md` using lone CR still fails generic close validation.** The team-row check accepted the projected table, but `finish` returned **1** and reported missing criteria, metrics, security, and canonical-update sections. Those readers still require LF or CRLF. A lone-CR retrospective block inside an otherwise LF close passed. The remaining inconsistency is at the full-document CLI boundary. All 23 `finish` invocations preserved the source close bytes. [Whole-CR result](/tmp/pace-t06-r22-independent.L3lCgJ/probes/projection/cr-valid-table.finish.json) · [Mixed-CR control](/tmp/pace-t06-r22-independent.L3lCgJ/controls/mixed-cr-valid-table/mixed-cr-valid-table.finish.json) · [Section reader](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/harness.ts:314) · [Metrics reader](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/metrics-report.ts:18)

### Criteria matrix

| Criterion | Result |
|---|---|
| **T-1 · Request measurement** | **Achieved in the tested scope.** Text stats and generated `METRICS.md` showed boundary `0`, total `1`, and no hold note. Boundary `1` showed an unknown total and the hold note in both outputs. Focused90 retained the cohort and comparison controls. Stage 14’s broader numerical observations remain historical evidence. [Formatter](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-metrics-document.ts:11) · [Paired assertions](/tmp/pace-t06-r22-independent.L3lCgJ/probes/results.json) |
| **T-2 · Period and role observations** | **Achieved in focused replay.** The older-root control retained in-period role, attempt, and kind observations. The independent Stage 14 numerical probes were outside this run. [Focused control](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/test/team-metrics.test.ts:781) |
| **T-3 · Comparison and legacy** | **Achieved in focused replay.** Comparison controls and the legacy adapter passed. The three T01 baseline inputs matched their `HEAD` hashes. The replay covered the new `owner` identifier, existing `by:user`, rejection of the old `captain` identifier, and acceptance of valid old responsibility prose. [Compatibility control](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/test/team-metrics.test.ts:486) · [T01 hashes](/tmp/pace-t06-r22-independent.L3lCgJ/t01-sha256.log) |
| **T-4 · Retrospective gate** | **Unmet.** Lone CR, CRLF, and LF respected the tested retrospective section, table, and fence boundaries. Filler-only direct, reference, and emphasized labels were rejected in headers and summaries. Visible Hangul, `A<B`, labeled angle URLs, and nested-parenthesis links passed. The two visible-cell rejections above still block acceptance. [Original assertions](/tmp/pace-t06-r22-independent.L3lCgJ/probes/results.json) · [Fresh controls](/tmp/pace-t06-r22-independent.L3lCgJ/controls/results.json) |
| **T-5 · Source CLI and acceptance** | **Synthetic workflow achieved. Overall acceptance unmet.** Focused90 exercised the role `--no-launch` path through stats, comparison, `METRICS.md`, retrospective, and `finish`. `runtimeObserved:false` leaves a live model call unverified. The full suite and broad native OS lock checks remain PM scope. The sandbox-denied `ps` observation remains unknown. [Workflow test](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/test/team-metrics.test.ts:115) · [Historical start event](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/run/role-flow/role-start.json) |

**Goal alignment holds.** The design carries BR01’s request-level reach definition and BR09’s ledger into BR06 measurement and the BR07 retrospective input. T06’s acceptance remains unmet and T07 still owes its device and skill verification. P009’s field outcome remains unknown. T08 adoption, efficacy, and the actual skill retrospective are held for the user after main merge and installation. [T06 contract](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/projects/P009_261123_프로젝트_맞춤_에이전트_팀/tasks/T06_팀_측정과_회고/TASK.md:26) · [P009 field scope](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/projects/P009_261123_프로젝트_맞춤_에이전트_팀/PROJECT.md:30)

I ran `node --test test/team-metrics.test.ts test/team.test.ts` once. The independent probes used `node <workspace>/bin/pace.ts project new`, `project finish P001`, `project stats P001`, and `project stats P001 --write` in owned temporary Git and `PACE_HOME` fixtures. There were **33 CLI invocations** across both probe scripts. Three initial positive controls inherited failed-finish findings from the shared fixture. I retained those outputs and reran only the affected controls in fresh repositories, including a mixed-CR control to isolate the team projection. Additional link probes were limited to the raw regex’s handling of escapes and quoted titles. The prior 193-probe run and broad request, comparison, and role suites were outside this recheck.
